jscOptionsMatching.name: useJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the executable pages to be allocated for JIT and thunks if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useBaselineJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the baseline JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useDFGJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the DFG JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useRegExpJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the RegExp JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useDOMJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the DOMJIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: jitMemoryReservationSize
jscOptionsMatching.description: Set this number to change the executable allocation size in ExecutableAllocatorFixedVMPool. (In bytes.)

jscOptionsMatching.name: dumpWasmDisassembly
jscOptionsMatching.description: dumps disassembly of all wasm code upon compilation

jscOptionsMatching.name: dumpWasmSourceFileName
jscOptionsMatching.description: log every wasm module validation, and dump source bytes to <filename>.0.wasm, <filename>.1.wasm, etc...

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmOMGFunctionsToDump
jscOptionsMatching.description: file with newline separated list of function indices to dump IR/disassembly for, if no such file exists, the function index itself

jscOptionsMatching.name: dumpBBQDisassembly
jscOptionsMatching.description: dumps disassembly of BBQ wasm code upon compilation

jscOptionsMatching.name: dumpOMGDisassembly
jscOptionsMatching.description: dumps disassembly of OMG wasm code upon compilation

jscOptionsMatching.name: useJITDump
jscOptionsMatching.description: generates JITDump side-data

jscOptionsMatching.name: useGdbJITInfo
jscOptionsMatching.description: generates GDB JIT API side-data; to use with lldb on macos, add `settings set plugin.jit-loader.gdb.enable on` to .lldbinit

jscOptionsMatching.name: jitDumpDirectory
jscOptionsMatching.description: Directory to place JITDump

jscOptionsMatching.name: bytecodeRangeToJITCompile
jscOptionsMatching.description: bytecode size range to allow compilation on, e.g. 1:100

jscOptionsMatching.name: jitAllowlist
jscOptionsMatching.description: file with newline separated list of function signatures to allow compilation on or, if no such file exists, the function signature to allow

jscOptionsMatching.name: bbqAllowlist
jscOptionsMatching.description: file with newline separated list of function indices to allow BBQ compilation on or, if no such file exists, the function index to allow

jscOptionsMatching.name: omgAllowlist
jscOptionsMatching.description: file with newline separated list of function indices to allow OMG compilation on or, if no such file exists, the function index to allow

jscOptionsMatching.name: useFTLJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the FTL JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useConcurrentJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the DFG / FTL compilation in threads other than the executing JS thread

jscOptionsMatching.name: maximumRegExpJITCodeSize
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum generated code size in bytes for RegExp JIT compilation before falling back to the interpreter.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningMaximumDepth
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum inlining depth to consider inlining a wasm function.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningMaximumWasmCalleeSize
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum wasm size in bytes to consider inlining a wasm function.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningMaximumCount
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum inlining count to consider inlining a wasm function.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningMinimumBudget
jscOptionsMatching.description: Minimum budget for which the wasmInliningFactor does not apply

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningFactor
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum multiple budget in comparison to initial wasm size

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningBudget
jscOptionsMatching.description: Maximum budget that allows inlining more

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningTinyFunctionThreshold
jscOptionsMatching.description: Wasm size threshold for tiny wasm functions

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmInliningSmallFunctionThreshold
jscOptionsMatching.description: Wasm size threshold for small wasm functions

jscOptionsMatching.name: jitPolicyScale
jscOptionsMatching.description: scale JIT thresholds to this specified ratio between 0.0 (compile ASAP) and 1.0 (compile like normal).

jscOptionsMatching.name: useLOLJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: Use LOL instead of Baseline

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasm
jscOptionsMatching.description: Expose the Wasm global object.

jscOptionsMatching.name: failToCompileWasmCode
jscOptionsMatching.description: If true, no Wasm::Plan will sucessfully compile a function.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmSmallPartialCompileLimit
jscOptionsMatching.description: Limit on the number of bytes a Wasm::Plan::compile should attempt for small wasm binary before checking for other work.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmLargePartialCompileLimit
jscOptionsMatching.description: Limit on the number of bytes a Wasm::Plan::compile should attempt for large wasm binary before checking for other work.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmOMGOptimizationLevel
jscOptionsMatching.description: B3 Optimization level for OMG Web Assembly module compilations.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useBBQTierUpChecks
jscOptionsMatching.description: Enables tier up checks for our BBQ code.

jscOptionsMatching.name: thresholdForBBQOptimizeAfterWarmUp
jscOptionsMatching.description: The count before we tier up a function to BBQ.

jscOptionsMatching.name: thresholdForOMGOptimizeAfterWarmUp
jscOptionsMatching.description: The count before we tier up a function to OMG.

jscOptionsMatching.name: omgTierUpCounterIncrementForLoop
jscOptionsMatching.description: The amount the tier up counter is incremented on each loop backedge.

jscOptionsMatching.name: omgTierUpCounterIncrementForEntry
jscOptionsMatching.description: The amount the tier up counter is incremented on each function entry.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmFastMemory
jscOptionsMatching.description: If true, we will try to use a 32-bit address space with a signal handler to bounds check wasm memory.

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmFastMemoryRedzonePages
jscOptionsMatching.description: Wasm fast memories use 4GiB virtual allocations, plus a redzone (counted as multiple of 64KiB Wasm pages) at the end to catch reg+imm accesses which exceed 32-bit, anything beyond the redzone is explicitly bounds-checked

jscOptionsMatching.name: crashIfWasmCantFastMemory
jscOptionsMatching.description: If true, we will crash if we can't obtain fast memory for wasm.

jscOptionsMatching.name: crashOnFailedWasmValidate
jscOptionsMatching.description: If true, we will crash if we can't validate a wasm module instead of throwing an exception.

jscOptionsMatching.name: verboseBBQJITAllocation
jscOptionsMatching.description: Logs extra information about register allocation during BBQ JIT

jscOptionsMatching.name: verboseBBQJITInstructions
jscOptionsMatching.description: Logs instruction information during BBQ JIT

jscOptionsMatching.name: disableBBQConsts
jscOptionsMatching.description: Wasm <type>.const instructions in BBQ JIT won't lower to a const BBQ::Value

jscOptionsMatching.name: useBBQJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the BBQ JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: useOMGJIT
jscOptionsMatching.description: allows the OMG JIT to be used if true

jscOptionsMatching.name: wasmFunctionIndexRangeToCompile
jscOptionsMatching.description: wasm function index range to allow compilation on, e.g. 1:100

jscOptionsMatching.name: useEagerWasmModuleHashing
jscOptionsMatching.description: Unnamed Wasm modules are identified in backtraces through their hash, if available.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmIPInt
jscOptionsMatching.description: Use the in-place interpereter for WASM instead of LLInt.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmIPIntPrologueOSR
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow IPInt to tier up during function prologues

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmIPIntLoopOSR
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow IPInt to tier up during loop iterations

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmIPIntEpilogueOSR
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow IPInt to tier up during function epilogues

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmIPIntSIMD
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow IPInt to interpret SIMD code

jscOptionsMatching.name: useOMGInlining
jscOptionsMatching.description: Use OMG inlining

jscOptionsMatching.name: freeRetiredWasmCode
jscOptionsMatching.description: free BBQ/OMG-OSR wasm code once it's no longer reachable.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmJSStringBuiltins
jscOptionsMatching.description: Enable the implementation of the JS String Builtins proposal.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmMemory64
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow the Memory64 proposal for WebAssembly. This feature is currently only supported in the IPInt tier.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmMemoryToBufferAPIs
jscOptionsMatching.description: Enable the toFixedLengthBuffer() and toResizableBuffer() Wasm Memory.prototype functions.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmRelaxedSIMD
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow the relaxed simd instructions and types from the wasm relaxed simd spec.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmSIMD
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow the new simd instructions and types from the wasm simd spec.

jscOptionsMatching.name: useWasmTailCalls
jscOptionsMatching.description: Allow the new instructions from the wasm tail calls spec.
